$comment: AI-assisted: Claude Opus 5.5 via Claude Code, 2026-11-24/25: settings of the demo video (plan M6.T11-T16 as re-scoped in plan/README.md section 3.6: rendered from the experiment harness's logs, no ROSA). LENGTH: course requirement (Canvas, Presentation Timing), as reported by Xiaohui on 2026-11-24: a pre-recorded demo of 3 to 5 minutes; length_s is a hard check on the assembled video (the assembly refuses anything outside it), aiming at about 4 minutes. With the car part: simulation about 2:00, car about 1:30, cards the rest; without it the simulation part takes target_s_without_car so the video stays inside the bound. Durations are parameters. Paths are relative to course-project/; outputs go to out_dir (git-ignored). MOTION: moves play in real time or at most x2 and each covers at least min_move_frames output frames (the lead's rule, 2026-11-25); only the waits are sped up. sim.motion 'glide' re-renders the commit-6a9c848 style (one time-lapse factor, each move a 0.3 s glide) as the fallback.
